steps.title: Set up breeding for pups
steps.instruction: Breed two females with one male to obtain P0‑P2 pups; check females 1 day after mating for a vaginal plug to estimate delivery at 19 ± 1 days after plug; use this timing to plan neuron preparation.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and sterilize equipment
steps.instruction: At least 2 days before neuron preparation, sterilize all solutions and disinfect all equipment with 70 % ethanol or autoclave; this applies to all reagents listed below.

steps.title: Make PBG (Papain) solution
steps.instruction: Combine 49.5 mL PBS with 50 mg BSA (1 mg/mL) and 0.5 mL 10 mM glucose to a total volume of 50 mL; aliquot and store at –20 °C for up to 6 months, avoiding freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Prepare PBS/Glucose dissection solution
steps.instruction: Mix 497.25 mL PBS with 2.75 mL 5.5 mM glucose to a final volume of 500 mL; filter‑sterilize (0.22 µm) and store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare plating medium
steps.instruction: In a sterile container combine 17.2 mL Neurobasal Plus, 0.4 mL B27 (0.02 %), 2 mL fetal calf serum (0.1 %), 0.2 mL Amphotericin B (50 µg), and 0.2 mL Gentamycin (2 mM) to a total of 20 mL; filter‑sterilize (0.22 µm) and store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare culture medium
steps.instruction: Mix 194 mL Neurobasal Plus, 4 mL B27 (0.02 %), and 2 mL L‑glutamine (2 mM) to a final volume of 200 mL; filter‑sterilize (0.22 µm) and store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Install and open Cluster Analysis plugin
steps.instruction: Open ImageJ/Fiji, install the custom Python‑based Cluster Analysis plugin from the GitHub repository, then launch it via Plugin > Cluster Analysis > Beta.

steps.title: Select input folder and manual region
steps.instruction: Choose the folder containing the image stack, set preferred parameters, select “manual selection” to define the proximal dendrite area, then pick the channels to analyze and enter their names.

substeps.instruction: Define background radius larger than a typical object (test via Process > Substrate Background > preview).
Set Gaussian blur to 1 (test via Process > Filters > Gaussian blur).

steps.title: Configure particle analysis parameters
steps.instruction: For each channel, set lower and upper particle sizes to 0.025–2.5, circulatory range to 1–2, choose a threshold method (e.g., Otsu or Triangle), enable Watershed algorithm, then click OK.

steps.title: Define ROI for proximal dendrite
steps.instruction: Enter a name for the manual selection (e.g., “proximal dendrite”), save the ROI using the “rotated rectangle” tool, and click OK, keeping the selection area constant across samples.

steps.title: Inspect detection and start experiment
steps.instruction: Compare detected puncta with the original image; if satisfactory, click “start experiment” to run the detection.

steps.title: Analyze results and calculate puncta density
steps.instruction: After processing, a “Particle Analysis” folder is created; open Particle Analysis > Output Table, divide particle counts by the selected dendrite area to obtain puncta density, plot density along the proximal dendrite for each experimental group, and finally unblind the data.
